questions.prompt: Before you sit, the most useful first habit is…

choices.text: Watch one orbit: seats, stacks, and who is playing which streets.
Post the big blind from the rail and throw cards in.
Announce your strategy to the table.
Buy the maximum and open every button immediately.

questions.explanation: A quiet orbit shows action order, stack sizes, and obvious tendencies.

choices.text: The first player to act preflop in a full ring.
The dealer position, last to act postflop.

questions.explanation: The button acts last on the flop, turn, and river in a normal hand.

questions.prompt: You are dealt in on the big blind your first hand. You should…

choices.text: Skip the blind because you just sat down.
Post the big blind; you are live for that hand.
Wait until the button passes you to post anything.

questions.explanation: A new player dealt into the big blind posts it and receives a hand.

questions.prompt: Missed-blind rules vary, but a safe default is…

choices.text: Invent a rule and enforce it yourself.
Never post and keep taking free hands.
Ask the dealer how this room handles a missed blind before you act.

questions.explanation: Rooms differ on posting, waiting, and dead blinds. The dealer is the source.
